name: ga4-manager-mcp
description: Manage GA4 properties and audit Search Console / SEO from Claude.
long_description: Exposes the GA4 Manager toolkit as MCP tools: GA4 property setup, reporting, cleanup and data-stream linking (via a bundled `ga4` CLI), Search Console analytics, coverage, cannibalization, CTR-anomaly and URL inspection, native SEO page/batch audits (optionally via Cloudflare Browser Rendering for JS-rendered pages) and consent-health checks, AdSense publisher reporting (earnings, page views, impressions, clicks, RPM), GA4 traffic and per-page ad revenue, URL-hygiene and hreflang checks, opt-in keyword research and live rank tracking (DataForSEO / ValueSERP), and a per-site growth brief that joins them for SEO and monetization planning. Runs locally so it can read your Google service-account credentials and talk to the Admin/Search Console/AdSense APIs on your behalf.

credentials.title: Google credentials JSON
credentials.description: Service-account key file, or an Application Default Credentials file (~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json).

project.title: Google Cloud project ID
project.description: The GCP project that owns the GA4 / Search Console access.

psi_api_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API key (optional)
psi_api_key.description: Enables Core Web Vitals in SEO audits. Leave blank to skip CWV.

cf_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID (optional)
cf_account_id.description: Enables render_js in SEO audits (Browser Rendering, for JS-rendered/SPA pages). Leave blank to skip.

cf_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token (optional)
cf_api_token.description: Paired with the Cloudflare account ID for render_js. Needs the Browser Rendering – Edit permission.

dataforseo_username.title: DataForSEO login (optional)
dataforseo_username.description: Enables keyword_volume and keyword_serp_snapshot. Leave blank to skip.

valueserp_api_key.title: ValueSERP API key (optional)
valueserp_api_key.description: Enables keyword_rank_check (live Google rank for a domain/keyword pair). Leave blank to skip.
